entities.summary: Keren Ann Zeidel, known professionally as Keren Ann, is a French and Dutch singer, songwriter, composer, producer, and engineer based largely in Paris, Tel Aviv, and New York City. She plays guitar, piano, and clarinet. She also engineers and writes choir and musical arrangements.
